content:
i take everything back and then a bit.
i can and will put GLotan on any team just for the sake of PrimChaos
i never seen such a big dissonance between how the kit reads and how it plays, it's fascinating
prim chaos is literally chaos but more fun, it's wild

Can agree. Before release I thought it was a contender for being the worst but it is just an alternate that is not bad at all, like everything else besides pcaro which I hate with the fiery hot passion of a thousand suns.
the dissonance really just come from uncertainty of how good the dual and triad posse and KF gain would be
I honestly barely felt the keyflare changes at all! I mean, i feel it, but it's not like a downgrade or anything, it really does feel fresh
And the posse changes as well, i thought i'd be pissed off by the RNG but literally any time i try to triple posse it feels really good
(in all fairness, the double posse is there just so i can use my keyflare again, cause i never go for it first lol)
I still wish it would trigger pure realms, but it feels in a really good place as is
I feel like you can wait for a better PChaos with a support skill set

kinda off topic but if we keep getting alt realms 
can we get new icon for Benthos/Singularity/Propagation/Primordia

No realm mastery double is a nice change and it makes sense. I just wish it still had DR... +100 is multiple times the last amount you need for breakpoints, and there's a good amount of DR abusers not only in other realms but also in Chaos itself
